children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 21, 2026) - Millennium Silver Corp.

("Millennium" or the "Company") announces that it has granted an aggregate of 9,440,000 incentive stock options to certain directors, officers, employees and consultants of the Company. The options are exercisable at a price of $0.05 per common share and expire on September 21, 2031. The options were granted pursuant to the Company's stock option plan and are subject to TSX Venture Exchange approval.
is focused on the exploration and development of its Nevada projects. The Company's common shares trade on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol: MSC.
